questions.stem: Which AWS Support plan is included for every AWS customer at no additional cost?

options.rationale: Developer Support is a paid plan.
Business Support is a paid plan.
Enterprise On-Ramp is a paid plan.
Basic Support is included for all customers and covers account and billing questions and documentation.

questions.explanation: Paid plans add technical support and more Trusted Advisor checks.

questions.stem: Which AWS Support plan includes a designated Technical Account Manager (TAM)?

options.rationale: Enterprise Support includes a designated TAM.
Business Support does not include a TAM.
Developer Support does not include a TAM.
Basic Support does not include technical support.

questions.explanation: Enterprise On-Ramp provides access to a pool of TAMs; Enterprise provides a designated TAM.

questions.stem: Which is the lowest-cost AWS Support plan that provides 24/7 phone, email and chat access to Cloud Support Engineers?

options.rationale: Developer Support offers email access during business hours.
Business Support adds 24/7 access to Cloud Support Engineers by phone, email and chat.
Enterprise On-Ramp also has 24/7 access but costs more.
Basic Support does not include technical support cases.

questions.explanation: Developer is for experimenting, Business for production workloads, Enterprise On-Ramp and Enterprise for business-critical workloads.

questions.stem: Which service recommends ways to reduce cost, improve performance and close security gaps, based on AWS best practices?

options.rationale: The Health Dashboard reports AWS service events.
Artifact provides compliance reports.
Trusted Advisor inspects your account and makes best-practice recommendations.
Marketplace is a software catalog.

questions.explanation: The full set of Trusted Advisor checks comes with Business Support and higher.

questions.stem: Where can a customer see AWS events that might affect its own resources, such as scheduled maintenance or a service issue in its Region?

options.rationale: Trusted Advisor gives best-practice recommendations.
CloudTrail records API calls.
Cost Explorer analyzes spending.
The Health Dashboard shows service health and events that affect your account.

questions.explanation: The AWS Health API gives programmatic access to the same events.

questions.stem: Which AWS-managed community lets customers ask technical questions and get answers from the community and AWS experts?

options.rationale: re:Post is a community question-and-answer service for AWS.
Artifact provides compliance reports.
Marketplace is a software catalog.
The Health Dashboard reports service events.

questions.explanation: The AWS Knowledge Center is part of re:Post.

questions.stem: A company sees that an AWS resource it does not own is sending spam to its users. Whom should it report this to?

options.rationale: Professional Services helps customers with projects.

options.text: The AWS Trust and Safety team
options.rationale: Trust and Safety handles reports of abuse involving AWS resources.
APN partners do not handle abuse reports.
Sellers do not handle abuse of AWS resources.

questions.explanation: Abuse such as spam, port scanning or malware hosting is reported to AWS Trust and Safety.

questions.stem: Which AWS team of experts helps customers achieve specific business outcomes on AWS, often working alongside AWS Partners?

options.text: The AWS Trust and Safety team
options.rationale: Trust and Safety handles abuse reports.
re:Post is a community Q&A service.
Professional Services is a global team of experts that supplements customer teams.
Artifact provides compliance reports.

questions.explanation: Other sources of expert help include AWS Solutions Architects and partners in the AWS Partner Network.

questions.stem: A company wants help from a third-party consulting firm that specializes in AWS migrations. Where should it look?

options.text: The AWS Trust and Safety team
options.rationale: Trust and Safety handles abuse reports.
The Health Dashboard reports service events.
Artifact provides compliance reports.
APN includes consulting partners and system integrators with AWS expertise.

questions.explanation: APN also includes independent software vendors (ISVs) that sell through AWS Marketplace.

questions.stem: Which resource provides time-tested strategies, guides and patterns from AWS and AWS Partners for migration and modernization projects?

options.rationale: Prescriptive Guidance offers strategies, guides and patterns for common projects.
Artifact provides compliance reports.
The Health Dashboard reports service events.
Marketplace is a software catalog.

questions.explanation: Technical resources include AWS documentation, whitepapers, blogs, Prescriptive Guidance, the Knowledge Center and re:Post.

questions.stem: Which TWO are categories of AWS Trusted Advisor checks? (Choose TWO.)

options.rationale: Data residency is not a Trusted Advisor category.
Machine learning is not a Trusted Advisor category.
Trusted Advisor checks for issues such as open ports and root MFA.
Licensing is not a Trusted Advisor category.
Trusted Advisor finds idle and underused resources.

questions.explanation: Trusted Advisor categories include cost optimization, performance, security, fault tolerance, service limits and operational excellence.
